q04.

The `SignIn` RPC is handled by `APIV1Service.SignIn` in `server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go` (implementation starts at line 51). This is the concrete implementation of the `AuthService.SignIn` RPC defined in the proto-generated code (`proto/gen/api/v1/auth_service_grpc.pb.go`), and is also wired up via a thin delegating wrapper `ConnectServiceHandler.SignIn` in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` (line 78) for the Connect protocol.

**Answer:** `AuthService.SignIn` — `server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go`
